notes.title: Fall Development Update
notes.notes:
[h1]What's up, kids.[/h1]

We haven't been talking to y'all much lately, have we? Been developing the living Inferno out of RAWMEN so don't be mad, aight? Tell you what: grab something good to eat and make yourself comfortable cause we got a surprise for ya.

[previewyoutube=ixtV5k4AZGY;full][/previewyoutube]

Why are you still reading this?! Go watch the vid! NOW! 

Oh, you have already. Good. So yeah, pretty much sums up what we've been up to. Hope you enjoyed the update. Now we have an excuse to be silent for another couple months, nice.

[h3]See you soup![/h3]


[b]Yours truly, 
Dustin & Eric[/b]

notes.title: RAWMEN Beta Patch! - 0.5.2.13
RAWMEN Alpha Demo update! - 0.4.3.8
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34437195/32e989df7bb600a8d61c1fc1aad13bff2050e81c.png[/img]

[h3]We pushed some lil fixes/changes to the ol' alpha - take a gander![/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed teammate highlights bug that increased visual distance of highlight, and prevents  enemy highlights.
[*] Removed twitch integration from quick-play
[*] Fixed a few UI bugs that persisted during game-play
[*] Fixed an issue where consecutive private/quickplay matches wouldn't start if a player left or disconnected
[*] Updated pots and ladles with new geometry for better soup holding

[/list]

Thanks for playin!

notes.title: RAWMEN - Quick Demo Update! 0.4.1.4
notes.notes:
We've done a quick fix for the following things within the Demo:
[b]
0.4.1.4[/b]

[list]
[*] Broth Dispensers now slowly heal over time
[*] Explosions now dismount players and ignore any mounting damage reduction
[*] Blocking no longer consumes soup and allows for soup regeneration
[*] Sliding no longer consumes soup and allows for soup regeneration
[*] Fixed animation bug with Bratling gun strafing
[*] HUD marker for mounting players updated
[*] Added new Meatball model to distinguish between explosive meatballs and game mode meatballs
[*] Added an idle pose for the customizer to allow for better character refinement
[*] Dim sum explosion radius slightly reduced
[/list]

If you were one of the unfortunate ones to have alpha access earlier helping us with builds previously, please follow these steps before downloading the demo.
(you wont be able to play with others if not)
[url=https://www.howtogeek.com/413055/how-to-hide-or-remove-a-game-from-your-steam-library/#:~:text=To%20permanently%20delete%20a%20game,the%20top%20of%20the%20list]https://www.howtogeek.com/413055/how-to-hide-or-remove-a-game-from-your-steam-library/#:~:text=To%20permanently%20delete%20a%20game,the%20top%20of%20the%20list[/url]
You will need to hide RAWMEN and remove it from your library before grabbing this!


Happy Daddy Day!

Thanks!
